title: Lesson 41 - Decision Drill: Choosing an Employee or a Service Agent From the Scenario
description: Given a scenario, identify when to use an Employee or Service agent.

questions.question: A support manager asks for an agent that lets signed-in customers on a portal view their own past cases and open a new one. Which type and mechanism fit?
options: A Service agent on an enhanced messaging channel with credential-based verification, so the signed-in customer runs as their own site user and sees only their cases
An Employee agent assigned to each customer
questions.explanation: The audience is external customers, so it is a Service agent, and credential-based verification is what limits each customer to their own records rather than the agent user's broader access.

questions.question: A firm wants the agent to email cold prospects and nurture them toward a meeting. Which choice fits?
options: A Service agent on Enhanced Chat
A Lead Nurturing agent, because the job is automated outbound email to prospects
A prompt template with no agent
questions.explanation: Automated outbound prospect email is the Lead Nurturing template's job, which separates it from both an Employee agent and an inbound Service agent.

questions.question: An operations team wants an agent in Slack that answers reps' questions about pipeline and drafts account summaries. Which type fits?
options: A Service agent on Enhanced Chat
An Employee agent, because the users are authenticated internal staff on an internal channel
A public Service agent on the website
questions.explanation: The audience is authenticated internal staff on an internal channel, so the agent runs as the logged-in rep, which is an Employee agent regardless of the chat surface.
